field_evidence.description: Details of every fire engine (pumping appliance) sent to an incident since January 2009, including deployment and arrival timing information.
field_evidence.update_statement: The main and smaller mobilisation datasets are updated every month.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade Mobilisation Records dataset, covering every fire-engine mobilisation to incidents since January 2009. The current resource 'LFB Mobilisation data 2025 onwards' covers January 2025 through July 2026, is updated monthly, and has Coordinates as its smallest geography. This batch binds the verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused coordinate-capable source window; coordinate-to-ward extraction, parcel spatial join and materialization are deferred to local OpenCode, so no incident rows, parcel geometry or parcel progress are claimed.
